note: USACE Louisville District campground on the Carr Fork arm of Carr Creek Lake, SE Kentucky mountains. Two playgrounds, picnic shelter, horseshoe, basketball and shuffleboard courts. The lake offers boating, skiing, swimming and fishing. Distinct from Carr Creek State Park on the same lake. --Claude
summary: Kept. USACE, rec.gov 232625: 45 reservable W/E sites (01-14 full hookup), $24-30 (high was 24), 50A, to 54 ft; 2027 season 04-01..10-09. Waterfront: recommend lakefront -> lakeview (pads ~3 m above summer pool, 25-35 m back behind a tree band on a narrow arm).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (recommend downgrade lakefront -> lakeview): the west-row pads (01, 03, 05, 07, 09, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21; all reservable nightly) stand at 315.2-316.5 m (3DEP) against Carr Creek Lake's summer pool of about 313.0 m (1,027 ft; the lidar water is 312.08 m), so ~2.5-3.5 m above it. Profile west from site 05 (37.23716,-82.94876): 316.0 m at 0 m, 315.4 at 16 m, 313.7 at 24 m, water at ~30 m - a 2-3 m bank, and imagery shows a band of trees and shrubs between most pads and the vegetated high-water line, with riprap below 01-03. The water is the narrow Carr Fork arm (~35-50 m at summer pool). Under the kayak test this is a view, not on-water; unsure after every source -> down to lakeview. The note's 'waterfront sites with direct lake access' (Claude wording) is dropped.
FEES: nightly_high 24 -> 30 (the full-hookup sites 01-14 and several W/E sites are $30; $24 is the B loop and some W/E sites).
SEASON: 2027 runs 04-01..10-09 (reservable from April 1); 2026 was 04-27..10-11 with walk-in only to 05-15.
PHONE 606-642-3052 matches rec.gov's facility phone; rec.gov also lists (606) 288-5471 for facility information (lake office). No change proposed.
PIN 37.2375,-82.9497222 sits ~35 m west of the B loop on the arm's west bank road; the loops are at ~37.2368,-82.9478 (~170 m). Under 250 m, no move needed.
